I'll start by reading the README to understand the contest requirements.

output:
1	# contest2026_252_EPG
2	
3	👋 欢迎参加 **2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛**！
4	
5	这是组委会为你的队伍创建的**专属参赛仓库**（本仓为样例/模板，队伍编号 `252`；你看到的将是你自己的 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>`）。比赛期间，你的全部参赛代码、打包产物与 AI Coding 日志都提交到这里。
6	
7	> 本仓既是「代码仓」，又内置了一键拉取整套 openvela 工程的 `repo` 清单（manifest）。你只需跟它打交道，**自始至终只动一个文件夹**。
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 一、先读这些官方文档
12	
13	**通用（所有赛道必读）：**
14	
15	| 文档                                                                                                                                     | 用途                                           |
16	| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
17	| [《大赛总览》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/contest_overview.md)                        | 赛道、流程、评分、资源，建议先通读             |
18	| [《参赛代码提交指南》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/code_submission_guide.md)           | 仓库获取、提交流程、时间与权限（**以此为准**） |
19	| [《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_coding_log_guide.md) | 如何导出 AI 对话日志并提交到 `logs/`           |
20	
21	**按你的赛道选读（三选一）：**
22	
23	| 赛道                  | 教程导航                                                                                                                                                 |
24	| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
25	| 快应用 / 手表应用创新 | [快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)                         |
26	| AI 硬件产品创新       | [AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)              |
27	| 新硬件适配            | [新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md) |
28	
29	---
30	
31	## 二、第一步：拉取完整工程
32	
33	用组委会提供的命令一键拉取「openvela 全量源码 + 你的专属仓」：
34	
35	```bash
36	repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_252_EPG \
37	  -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_252_EPG.xml
38	repo sync -c -j8
39	```
40	
41	同步后，你的整个仓库位于工作区的 `contest2026_252_EPG/`，openvela 全量源码在外层（`nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/`、`vendor/` 等）。
42	
43	---
44	
45	## 三、第二步：在哪里写代码
46	
47	**只在自己的仓目录 `contest2026_252_EPG/` 里开发。** 不同作品形态放在对应子目录，manifest 会通过 `<linkfile>` 把它们**软链**到 openvela 编译树该在的位置——你不用手动 copy：
48	
49	| 作品形态 | 你的代码放这里             | 系统自动映射到                                 |
50	| -------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
51	| 应用     | `app/hello_app/`           | `packages/demos/contest2026_252_hello_app`     |
52	| 快应用   | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_252_hello_quickapp` |
53	| 板级适配 | `board/contest_board/`     | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_252_board` |
54	
55	> 用不到的形态目录可以删掉；新增作品时按同样规则加子目录，并在 `contest2026_252_EPG.xml` 里补一条 `<linkfile>` 映射即可。**生产仓库（packages/nuttx/vendor 等）零改动。**
56	
57	建议仓库目录约定（便于评委定位）：
58	
59	```text
60	app/ | quickapp/ | board/   # 你的作品代码
61	logs/                       # AI Coding 日志（主动导出后提交，格式见 logs/README.md）
62	README.md                   # 作品说明（提交前请改成你自己的，见第六节）
63	```
64	
65	> 仓内附带了一个 `.gitignore.example`，给出了**编译产物**等不需要进仓的文件示例。如需启用，`cp .gitignore.example .gitignore` 后按需增删即可。**注意 `logs/` 下最终导出的 AI Coding 日志必须提交，不要忽略。**
66	>
67	> `logs/` 的目录结构与提交格式见 [logs/README.md](logs/README.md)。
68	
69	---
70	
71	## 四、第三步：编译与运行
72	
73	编译/运行步骤随作品形态不同而不同，请参考你所在赛道的教程导航：
74	
75	- 快应用 / 手表应用：[快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)（含模拟器与开发板部署）。
76	- AI 硬件产品创新：[AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)（环境搭建、编译烧录、Skill 开发）。
77	- 新硬件适配：[新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md)（BSP 移植、最小 NSH 基线）。
78	
79	子目录已通过 manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 软链进 openvela 编译树，因此构建在 openvela 工作区**根目录**（即你这个仓的上一级）进行。openvela 使用 `build.sh` 作为统一入口，接收一个 **board config 路径**作为参数：
80	
81	```bash
82	# 进入 openvela 工作区根目录（你的仓的上一级）
83	cd ..
84	
85	# 通用语法：第一个参数是 board config 路径，第二个参数可以是 menuconfig / distclean 等
86	./build.sh <board-config-path> [menuconfig|distclean] [-j8]
87	```
88	
89	> 具体的 board config 路径、目标产物、模拟器/真机部署方式请以你所在赛道的教程导航为准。本仓 `app/` `quickapp/` `board/` 三个示例骨架对应的 Kconfig 选项可通过 `menuconfig` 启用。
90	
91	---
92	
93	## 五、第四步：提交作品
94	
95	1. **fork** 你的专属仓 → 开发 → `git commit` 并推送 → 向专属仓发起 **Pull Request**，可**自行 review 并合入**（无需等组委会）。
96	2. **AI Coding 日志**：与 AI 工具的对话会自动记录到本机 staging（不会自动上传），需你**主动导出/打包**选定会话到仓内 `logs/` 目录后一并提交。详见[《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_coding_log_guide.md)。
97	3. 若需改动 **nuttx 等公共仓库**，不在本仓改，而是 fork 对应公共仓、以 PR 提交到 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支，由组委会 review 后合入。
98	
99	> ⏰ **提交作品截止：9 月 20 日**。截止后统一收回 push 权限，仍可查看 / clone。
100	>
101	> 获奖后再按要求将作品 PR 至 openvela 上游对应仓库（走标准 PR + CI 流程）。
102	
103	### 关于 PR 与 CLA
104	
105	- 本仓所有改动通过 **Pull Request** 合入（分支保护强制，可自行合入自己的 PR）。
106	- 首次贡献需在[**官网签署 CLA**](https://openvela.com/#/community/cla)；PR 上会自动跑 `cla/signature` 检查，在官网签署成功后，在 PR 评论 `/check-cla` 复检即可通过。
107	
108	---
109	
110	## 六、提交前：把本 README 改成你的作品说明
111	
112	本文件目前是组委会给的**使用说明书**。**作品提交前，请把它替换成你自己作品的说明**，方便评委快速了解你做了什么、怎么跑起来。建议至少包含以下内容：
113	
114	```markdown
115	# <你的作品名>
116	
117	## 一、作品简介
118	<一句话/一段话说明这个作品是什么、解决什么问题、亮点在哪>
119	
120	## 二、选题方向
121	<快应用 / 手表应用创新 ｜ AI 硬件产品创新 ｜ 新硬件适配 ｜ 自定方向，并简述理由>
122	
123	## 三、目录结构
124	<列出你这个仓里各目录/文件的作用，例如：>
125	- `app/xxx/`        — <说明>
126	- `board/xxx/`      — <说明>
127	- `quickapp/xxx/`   — <说明>
128	- `logs/`           — AI Coding 日志
129	- `docs/` 或其他    — <说明>
130	
131	## 四、运行方式
132	<拉取工程后，如何编译、烧录/部署、运行的完整步骤；最好能让评委照着一步步复现>
133	
134	## 五、AI Coding 使用说明
135	<说明本作品如何借助 AI 辅助开发：
136	- 在需求拆解 / 方案设计 / 编码 / 调试 / 文档等环节如何与 AI 协作；
137	- AI 对开发效率或质量带来的实际帮助。
138	完整对话日志见 logs/ 目录>
139	```
140	
141	> 提示：将会根据「作品本身 + 你的 README 说明 + `logs/` 里的 AI Coding 日志」来理解和评估你的作品，README 写清楚很重要。
142	
143	---
144	
145	## 附：仓库命名规范
146	
147	`contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>` — 编号三位零填充；队名 slug（全小写、英文/拼音、连字符）。例：`contest2026_252_EPG`。
148	（仓库由组委会统一创建，**每队仅一个仓**，无需自行命名。）
149

# Hardware Porting Track Guide - Summary

## Contest Objective
The initiative aims to "accelerate openvela's hardware ecosystem diversification" by encouraging participants to adapt openvela to additional chipsets and development boards.

## Core Requirements

**Participants must:**
1. Select an unadapted hardware platform not currently supported by openvela
2. Complete end-to-end porting including BSP, driver development, and system construction
3. Ensure openvela boots normally and runs core functionality on target hardware

## Adaptation Scope (Examples)

The guide identifies several focus areas:
- Chip-level BSP development and porting
- Peripheral drivers (UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, Display, Audio, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)
- Boot sequences and memory optimization
- Build system integration (defconfig, toolchain adaptation)
- Hardware capability verification and basic functionality demos

## Deliverables

Teams must submit:
- Functional openvela boot implementation with console output capability
- Adaptation code including defconfig configurations, board initialization code, and necessary drivers
- Board-level adaptation code placed in a dedicated GitHub repository subdirectory
- AI Coding conversation logs exported to a `logs/` directory
- Detailed adaptation documentation for reproducibility

## Submission Process

Organizers create dedicated repositories per team (`contest2026_<number>_<teamname>`). Teams fork their dedicated repository, create PRs, and self-review merges. Post-competition, winning adaptations proceed through standard upstream PR processes to vendor-specific repositories.

## Scoring Advantages

This track emphasizes "technical difficulty" (30-point dimension) through:
- Broader hardware platform coverage with comprehensive drivers
- Application demos using adapted capabilities
- Novel architectures (RISC-V, MIPS) or domestic chip platforms
- Deep optimization for specialized hardware features
- High code quality suitable for mainline integration
- Comprehensive adaptation guides for reproducibility

## AI Development Support

openvela provides skill sets including driver development (`nuttx-driver-development`), code review capability (`driver-code-reviewer`), and workflow agents (`driver-workflow`) to support participants throughout development.

=== build-macos.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# build-macos.sh — 在 macOS (Apple Silicon) 上一键编译 openvela 目标
#
# 用法:
#   ./build-macos.sh                 # 默认编译 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap
#   ./build-macos.sh <config-dir>    # 指定其它配置
#   ./build-macos.sh <config-dir> distclean   # 透传目标(如 distclean/menuconfig)
#
# 它会:
#   1. source macos-env.sh（前置 bash5/GNU 工具、修 cmake 遮蔽、装 jidl Docker wrapper）
#   2. 调用官方 ./build.sh ... --cmake
#   3. 针对 ffmpeg out-of-tree 首次构建的对象目录顺序问题自动重试一次
#      （首次 `make context` 时 config.mak 尚未生成，对象子目录未建；第二遍即可）
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

CONFIG="${1:-vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/}"
shift || true
EXTRA_TARGET=("$@")
JOBS="-j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 8)"

source ./macos-env.sh

run_build() {
  # bash 3.2 的 set -u 会把空数组展开当作 unbound variable，用 ${arr[@]+...} 规避
  ./build.sh "${CONFIG}" --cmake "${JOBS}" ${EXTRA_TARGET[@]+"${EXTRA_TARGET[@]}"}
}

echo "=== build-macos: ${CONFIG} ${EXTRA_TARGET[*]-} ${JOBS} ==="
if run_build; then
  echo "=== 构建成功 ==="
  exit 0
fi

# 失败：若疑似 ffmpeg 首次对象目录问题，config.mak 现已生成，重试一次
echo "=== 首次构建失败，自动重试一次（覆盖 ffmpeg 对象目录首建顺序问题）==="
if run_build; then
  echo "=== 重试后构建成功 ==="
  exit 0
fi
echo "=== 构建仍失败，请查看上方日志 ===" >&2
exit 1

# For a description of the syntax of this configuration file,
# see the file kconfig-language.txt in the NuttX tools repository.
#
# BK7258 (Beken) chip layer for openvela / NuttX.

comment "BK7258 Configuration Options"

choice
	prompt "Beken Chip Selection"
	default ARCH_CHIP_BK7258

config ARCH_CHIP_BK7258
	bool "bk7258"
	select ARCH_ARMV8M
	select ARCH_CORTEXM33
	select ARCH_HAVE_FPU
	select ARCH_HAVE_MPU
	select ARCH_HAVE_FETCHADD
	select ARM_HAVE_MPU_UNIFIED
	select ARMV8M_HAVE_STACKCHECK
	select ARMV8M_USEBASEPRI
	---help---
		Beken BK7258: Armv8-M STAR-MC1 (Cortex-M33 compatible) MCU up to
		480MHz, with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth LE 5.4, 640KB shared SRAM,
		XIP flash and SiP PSRAM.

endchoice

menu "BK7258 Peripheral Support"

config BK7258_UART0
	bool "UART0"
	default y
	select UART0_SERIALDRIVER
	select ARCH_HAVE_SERIAL_TERMIOS
	---help---
		UART0 is routed to GPIO10 (RX) / GPIO11 (TX), which is the same
		pin pair used by the ROM flash-download engine (DL_UART).  On the
		Agora ConvoAI Kit R1 these pins are wired to the on-board CH340
		USB-serial bridge, so UART0 is the natural console.

config BK7258_UART1
	bool "UART1"
	default n
	select UART1_SERIALDRIVER
	select ARCH_HAVE_SERIAL_TERMIOS
	---help---
		UART1 on GPIO0 (TX) / GPIO1 (RX).

config BK7258_UART2
	bool "UART2"
	default n
	select UART2_SERIALDRIVER
	select ARCH_HAVE_SERIAL_TERMIOS
	---help---
		UART2 on GPIO40 (RX) / GPIO41 (TX), alternate GPIO30/GPIO31.

endmenu # BK7258 Peripheral Support

endif # ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM

 *
 * BK7258 memory map and peripheral base addresses.

 * Addresses are taken from the Beken SDK (bk_idk release/v2.0.1),

#ifndef __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_MEMORYMAP_H
#define __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_MEMORYMAP_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Distance between the secure and non-secure alias of any address */

#define BK7258_S_NS_ADDR_DIFF   0x10000000ul

/* Tightly coupled memories (16 KB each) */

#define BK7258_ITCM_BASE        0x00000000ul
#define BK7258_DTCM_BASE        0x20000000ul

/* Execute-in-place flash and mask ROM */

#define BK7258_FLASH_BASE       0x02000000ul
#define BK7258_ROM_BASE         0x06000000ul

/* Shared SRAM.
 *
 * The six SRAM banks are physically contiguous and total 640 KB.  The same
 * physical memory is visible through four windows; 0x08000000/0x18000000 are
 * the instruction views and 0x28000000/0x38000000 the data views.
 */

#define BK7258_SRAM_IBASE       0x08000000ul  /* Instruction view */
#define BK7258_SRAM_BASE        0x28000000ul  /* Data view */
#define BK7258_SRAM_SIZE        0x000a0000ul  /* 640 KB */
#define BK7258_SRAM_END         (BK7258_SRAM_BASE + BK7258_SRAM_SIZE)

/* Offset from the SRAM data view to the SRAM instruction view */

#define BK7258_SRAM_IOFFSET     (BK7258_SRAM_BASE - BK7258_SRAM_IBASE)

#define BK7258_QSPI0_BASE       0x64000000ul

#define __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_UART_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include "bk7258_memorymap.h"

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* The UART clock is the 26 MHz high-speed crystal (XTALH).  This matches
 * UART_CLOCK == CONFIG_XTAL_FREQ == 26000000 in the Beken SDK.
 */

#define BK7258_UART_CLOCK       26000000

/* Register offsets *********************************************************/

#define BK7258_UART_DEVID_OFFSET        0x0000  /* Device ID */
#define BK7258_UART_VERSION_OFFSET      0x0004  /* Device version */
#define BK7258_UART_GLOBAL_CTRL_OFFSET  0x0008  /* Global control */
#define BK7258_UART_DEVSTATUS_OFFSET    0x000c  /* Device status */
#define BK7258_UART_CONFIG_OFFSET       0x0010  /* Line configuration */
#define BK7258_UART_FIFO_CONFIG_OFFSET  0x0014  /* FIFO configuration */
#define BK7258_UART_FIFO_STATUS_OFFSET  0x0018  /* FIFO status */
#define BK7258_UART_FIFO_PORT_OFFSET    0x001c  /* FIFO data port */
#define BK7258_UART_INT_ENABLE_OFFSET   0x0020  /* Interrupt enable */
#define BK7258_UART_INT_STATUS_OFFSET   0x0024  /* Interrupt status */

/* Global control register **************************************************/

#define UART_GLOBAL_SOFT_RESET      (1 << 0)  /* Bit 0:  Soft reset */
#define UART_GLOBAL_CLKGATE_BYPASS  (1 << 1)  /* Bit 1:  Bypass clock gate */

/* Line configuration register **********************************************/

#define UART_CONFIG_TX_ENABLE       (1 << 0)  /* Bit 0:  Transmit enable */
#define UART_CONFIG_RX_ENABLE       (1 << 1)  /* Bit 1:  Receive enable */
#define UART_CONFIG_IRDA_MODE       (1 << 2)  /* Bit 2:  0=UART, 1=IrDA */

#define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT  (3)       /* Bits 3-4: Data bits */
#define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_MASK   (3 << UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT)
#  define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_5    (0 << UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT)
#  define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_6    (1 << UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT)
#  define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_7    (2 << UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT)
#  define UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_8    (3 << UART_CONFIG_DATABITS_SHIFT)

#define UART_CONFIG_PARITY_ENABLE   (1 << 5)  /* Bit 5:  Parity enable */
#define UART_CONFIG_PARITY_ODD      (1 << 6)  /* Bit 6:  0=even, 1=odd */
#define UART_CONFIG_STOPBITS_2      (1 << 7)  /* Bit 7:  0=1 stop, 1=2 stop */

#define UART_CONFIG_CLKDIV_SHIFT    (8)       /* Bits 8-23: Clock divider */
#define UART_CONFIG_CLKDIV_MASK     (0xffff << UART_CONFIG_CLKDIV_SHIFT)
#define UART_CONFIG_CLKDIV(n)       ((uint32_t)(n) << UART_CONFIG_CLKDIV_SHIFT)

/* Baud rate is UART_CLOCK / (clk_div + 1); round to nearest to minimise
 * error (uart_ll.h in the Beken SDK derives the baud the same way).
 */

#define UART_CLKDIV(baud) \
  (((BK7258_UART_CLOCK + ((baud) / 2)) / (baud)) - 1)

/* FIFO configuration register **********************************************/

#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_TXTHR_SHIFT  (0)     /* Bits 0-7:  TX threshold */
#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_TXTHR_MASK   (0xff << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_TXTHR_SHIFT)
#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_TXTHR(n) \
  ((uint32_t)(n) << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_TXTHR_SHIFT)

#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_RXTHR_SHIFT  (8)     /* Bits 8-15: RX threshold */
#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_RXTHR_MASK   (0xff << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_RXTHR_SHIFT)
#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_RXTHR(n) \
  ((uint32_t)(n) << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_RXTHR_SHIFT)

#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT (16)   /* Bits 16-17: RX stop detect */
#define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_MASK  (3 << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT)
#  define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_32  (0 << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT)
#  define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_64  (1 << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT)
#  define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_128 (2 << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT)
#  define UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_256 (3 << UART_FIFO_CONFIG_STOPDET_SHIFT)

/* FIFO status register *****************************************************/

#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_TXCNT_SHIFT  (0)     /* Bits 0-7:  TX FIFO count */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_TXCNT_MASK   (0xff << UART_FIFO_STATUS_TXCNT_SHIFT)
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_RXCNT_SHIFT  (8)     /* Bits 8-15: RX FIFO count */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_RXCNT_MASK   (0xff << UART_FIFO_STATUS_RXCNT_SHIFT)

#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_TX_FULL      (1 << 16) /* Bit 16: TX FIFO full */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_TX_EMPTY     (1 << 17) /* Bit 17: TX FIFO empty */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_RX_FULL      (1 << 18) /* Bit 18: RX FIFO full */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_RX_EMPTY     (1 << 19) /* Bit 19: RX FIFO empty */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_WR_READY     (1 << 20) /* Bit 20: Write ready */
#define UART_FIFO_STATUS_RD_READY     (1 << 21) /* Bit 21: Read ready */

/* FIFO data port register **************************************************/

#define UART_FIFO_PORT_TXDATA_SHIFT   (0)     /* Bits 0-7:  TX data in */
#define UART_FIFO_PORT_TXDATA_MASK    (0xff << UART_FIFO_PORT_TXDATA_SHIFT)
#define UART_FIFO_PORT_RXDATA_SHIFT   (8)     /* Bits 8-15: RX data out */
#define UART_FIFO_PORT_RXDATA_MASK    (0xff << UART_FIFO_PORT_RXDATA_SHIFT)

/* Interrupt enable / interrupt status registers ****************************/

#define UART_INT_TX_NEED_WRITE      (1 << 0)  /* Bit 0: TX FIFO below thresh */
#define UART_INT_RX_NEED_READ       (1 << 1)  /* Bit 1: RX FIFO above thresh */
#define UART_INT_RX_OVERFLOW        (1 << 2)  /* Bit 2: RX FIFO overflow */
#define UART_INT_RX_PARITY_ERR      (1 << 3)  /* Bit 3: RX parity error */
#define UART_INT_RX_STOPBITS_ERR    (1 << 4)  /* Bit 4: RX stop bit error */
#define UART_INT_TX_FINISH          (1 << 5)  /* Bit 5: TX complete */
#define UART_INT_RX_FINISH          (1 << 6)  /* Bit 6: RX complete */
#define UART_INT_RXD_WAKEUP         (1 << 7)  /* Bit 7: RX wakeup */

/* All receive-side interrupt sources */

#define UART_INT_RX_ALL \
  (UART_INT_RX_NEED_READ | UART_INT_RX_FINISH)

/* All error interrupt sources */

#define UART_INT_ERROR_ALL \
  (UART_INT_RX_OVERFLOW | UART_INT_RX_PARITY_ERR | UART_INT_RX_STOPBITS_ERR)

#endif /* __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_UART_H */

#define __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_GPIO_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "bk7258_memorymap.h"

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

#define BK7258_NGPIOS               56

/* Per-pin configuration register, one 32-bit word per pin. */

#define BK7258_GPIO_CFG(n)          (BK7258_AON_GPIO_BASE + ((n) << 2))

#define GPIO_CFG_INPUT              (1 << 0)  /* Bit 0:  Input value (RO) */
#define GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT             (1 << 1)  /* Bit 1:  Output value */
#define GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN           (1 << 2)  /* Bit 2:  Input enable */
#define GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN          (1 << 3)  /* Bit 3:  Output enable */
#define GPIO_CFG_PULL_UP            (1 << 4)  /* Bit 4:  1=pull up, 0=down */
#define GPIO_CFG_PULL_EN            (1 << 5)  /* Bit 5:  Pull enable */
#define GPIO_CFG_FUNC_EN            (1 << 6)  /* Bit 6:  Peripheral function */
#define GPIO_CFG_INPUT_MONITOR      (1 << 7)  /* Bit 7:  Input monitor */
#define GPIO_CFG_CAPACITY_SHIFT     (8)       /* Bits 8-9:   Drive strength */
#define GPIO_CFG_CAPACITY_MASK      (3 << GPIO_CFG_CAPACITY_SHIFT)
#define GPIO_CFG_INT_TYPE_SHIFT     (10)      /* Bits 10-11: Interrupt type */
#define GPIO_CFG_INT_TYPE_MASK      (3 << GPIO_CFG_INT_TYPE_SHIFT)
#define GPIO_CFG_INT_EN             (1 << 12) /* Bit 12: Interrupt enable */
#define GPIO_CFG_INT_CLEAR          (1 << 13) /* Bit 13: Interrupt clear */

/* Peripheral (alternate) function select.  These registers live in the
 * system register block, not the GPIO block: eight pins per 32-bit word,
 * four bits each.  The value is the index into the pin's alternate function
 * list, so the datasheet's "AF1" column is index 0.
 */

#define BK7258_GPIO_FUNCMODE_BASE   (BK7258_SYS_BASE + (0x30 << 2))
#define BK7258_GPIO_FUNCMODE(n)     (BK7258_GPIO_FUNCMODE_BASE + (((n) >> 3) << 2))
#define GPIO_FUNCMODE_SHIFT(n)      ((((n) & 7)) << 2)
#define GPIO_FUNCMODE_MASK(n)       (0xful << GPIO_FUNCMODE_SHIFT(n))

/* Alternate function indices used by this port.
 *
 * Note the Beken SDK names the UART devices one higher than the register
 * blocks: its GPIO_DEV_UART1_TXD is the alternate function of the UART0
 * register block.  The pin assignments here follow the datasheet, where
 * GPIO10/GPIO11 are UART0 RX/TX (and double as the ROM flash-download pins).
 */

#define BK7258_GPIO_AF0             0
#define BK7258_GPIO_AF1             1
#define BK7258_GPIO_AF2             2

/* Console/UART pin assignments (BK7258 datasheet table 3-5) */

#define BK7258_GPIO_UART0_RX        10
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART0_TX        11
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART0_AF        BK7258_GPIO_AF0

#define BK7258_GPIO_UART1_TX        0
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART1_RX        1
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART1_AF        BK7258_GPIO_AF0

#define BK7258_GPIO_UART2_RX        40
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART2_TX        41
#define BK7258_GPIO_UART2_AF        BK7258_GPIO_AF0

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Function Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_gpio_setaf
 *
 * Description:
 *   Route a pin to one of its peripheral functions.  'af' is the index into
 *   the pin's alternate function list as given in the datasheet pin
 *   multiplexing table, counting the AF1 column as index 0.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void bk7258_gpio_setaf(int pin, uint8_t af);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_gpio_config
 *
 * Description:
 *   Configure a pin as plain GPIO input or output, optionally with a pull
 *   resistor.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void bk7258_gpio_config(int pin, bool output, bool pullup, bool pulldown);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_gpio_write / bk7258_gpio_read
 ****************************************************************************/

void bk7258_gpio_write(int pin, bool value);
bool bk7258_gpio_read(int pin);

#endif /* __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_GPIO_H */

/* System control registers.  The Beken SDK addresses these by word index;
 * the byte offsets below are those indices multiplied by four.
 */

#define BK7258_SYS_CPU_CLKDIV_MODE1 (BK7258_SYS_BASE + (0x08 << 2))
#define BK7258_SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CKEN  (BK7258_SYS_BASE + (0x0c << 2))

/* CPU clock divider / select register (word 0x08) */

#define SYS_CLKDIV_CORE_SHIFT       (0)       /* Bits 0-3:   Core divider */
#define SYS_CLKDIV_CORE_MASK        (0xf << SYS_CLKDIV_CORE_SHIFT)
#define SYS_CKSEL_CORE_SHIFT        (4)       /* Bits 4-5:   Core source */
#define SYS_CKSEL_CORE_MASK         (0x3 << SYS_CKSEL_CORE_SHIFT)
#define SYS_CLKDIV_BUS              (1 << 6)  /* Bit 6:      Bus divider */

#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART0_SHIFT      (8)       /* Bits 8-9:   UART0 divider */
#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART0_MASK       (0x3 << SYS_CLKDIV_UART0_SHIFT)
#define SYS_CLKSEL_UART0            (1 << 10) /* Bit 10:  0=XTAL26M, 1=APLL */

#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART1_SHIFT      (11)      /* Bits 11-12: UART1 divider */
#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART1_MASK       (0x3 << SYS_CLKDIV_UART1_SHIFT)
#define SYS_CLKSEL_UART1            (1 << 13) /* Bit 13:  0=XTAL26M, 1=APLL */

#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART2_SHIFT      (14)      /* Bits 14-15: UART2 divider */
#define SYS_CLKDIV_UART2_MASK       (0x3 << SYS_CLKDIV_UART2_SHIFT)
#define SYS_CLKSEL_UART2            (1 << 16) /* Bit 16:  0=XTAL26M, 1=APLL */

/* Device clock enable register (word 0x0c) */

#define SYS_CKEN_I2C0               (1 << 0)
#define SYS_CKEN_SPI0               (1 << 1)
#define SYS_CKEN_UART0              (1 << 2)
#define SYS_CKEN_PWM0               (1 << 3)
#define SYS_CKEN_TIM0               (1 << 4)
#define SYS_CKEN_SADC               (1 << 5)
#define SYS_CKEN_IRDA               (1 << 6)
#define SYS_CKEN_EFUSE              (1 << 7)
#define SYS_CKEN_I2C1               (1 << 8)
#define SYS_CKEN_SPI1               (1 << 9)
#define SYS_CKEN_UART1              (1 << 10)
#define SYS_CKEN_UART2              (1 << 11)

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Function Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_clockconfig
 *
 * Description:
 *   Bring up the clocks this port depends on.  The boot ROM and the Beken
 *   bootloader have already configured the core PLL and the flash
 *   controller, so this only has to enable and route the peripheral clocks
 *   that NuttX drives itself.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void bk7258_clockconfig(void);

 *

void bk7258_uart_clockenable(int uart);

#endif /* __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_CHIP_BK7258_CLOCKCONFIG_H */

/* Clocking *****************************************************************/

/* The BK7258 runs from a 26 MHz crystal (XTALH).  The bootloader has already
 * locked the DPLL and switched the core over by the time NuttX starts; the
 * core runs at 120 MHz in the bootloader's default configuration.
 */

#define BOARD_XTAL_FREQUENCY    26000000
#define BOARD_CPU_FREQUENCY     120000000

/* up_udelay() calibration.  This is a starting estimate for a 120 MHz core;
 * refine it with apps/examples/calib_udelay if precise delays are needed.
 */

#define BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC      12000

/* UART pin assignment ******************************************************/

/* UART0 (GPIO10 = RX, GPIO11 = TX) is the console.  These are the pads the
 * boot ROM uses for its flash-download protocol, and on this board they are
 * wired to the CH340 USB-serial bridge behind the USB-C connector.
 */

#define BOARD_CONSOLE_UART      0

#endif /* __BOARD_CONTEST_BOARD_INCLUDE_BOARD_H */

/* NVIC priority levels */

#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN      0xff /* All bits set in minimum priority */
#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT  0x80 /* Midpoint is the default */
#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX      0x00 /* Zero is maximum priority */
#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_STEP     0x40 /* Steps between supported priority */

/* If CONFIG_ARMV8M_USEBASEPRI is selected, then interrupts will be disabled
 * by setting the BASEPRI register to NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY, so that
 * priority levels above that value are never masked.  SVCall must sit at the
 * highest priority so that a system call can still be taken while ordinary
 * interrupts are masked.
 */

#define NVIC_SYSH_MAXNORMAL_PRIORITY \
  (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX + NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_STEP)
#define NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY  NVIC_SYSH_MAXNORMAL_PRIORITY
#define NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY   NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Encode a BK7258 image into the CRC-checked layout the flash controller expects.

The BK7258 flash controller verifies a CRC while fetching instructions over
XIP.  It stores two CRC bytes after every 32 bytes of payload, so 32 bytes of
"virtual" (CPU-visible) data occupy 34 bytes of physical flash.  A raw
``nuttx.bin`` therefore has to be re-encoded before it is programmed.

The CRC is a 16-bit MSB-first CRC with polynomial 0x8005 and an initial value
of 0xFFFF, stored big-endian.  That was determined by brute-forcing the
parameters against the CRC-encoded binaries shipped in the Beken SDK
(bk_idk release/v2.0.1, components/secure_calibration/package_for_calibration)
and verified to reproduce every one of the 3868 blocks in those files exactly.
``--verify`` re-runs that check against any known-good encoded image.

Usage::

    ./bk_crc_pack.py nuttx.bin nuttx_crc.bin
    ./bk_crc_pack.py --verify some_known_crc.bin
"""

import argparse
import sys

BLOCK_DATA = 32
BLOCK_CRC = 2
BLOCK_TOTAL = BLOCK_DATA + BLOCK_CRC

CRC_POLY = 0x8005
CRC_INIT = 0xFFFF

# Pad byte for the final short block.  Erased flash reads as 0xFF, so padding
# with 0xFF keeps the encoded image consistent with an erased device.
PAD_BYTE = 0xFF


def crc16(data: bytes, crc: int = CRC_INIT) -> int:
    """MSB-first CRC-16, polynomial 0x8005, initial value 0xFFFF."""
    for byte in data:
        crc ^= byte << 8
        for _ in range(8):
            if crc & 0x8000:
                crc = ((crc << 1) ^ CRC_POLY) & 0xFFFF
            else:
                crc = (crc << 1) & 0xFFFF
    return crc


def encode(payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Interleave CRCs into payload, padding the last block if needed."""
    if len(payload) % BLOCK_DATA:
        payload += bytes([PAD_BYTE]) * (BLOCK_DATA - len(payload) % BLOCK_DATA)

    out = bytearray()
    for off in range(0, len(payload), BLOCK_DATA):
        block = payload[off:off + BLOCK_DATA]
        out += block
        out += crc16(block).to_bytes(2, "big")
    return bytes(out)


def verify(encoded: bytes) -> int:
    """Return the number of blocks whose stored CRC does not match."""
    if len(encoded) % BLOCK_TOTAL:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"not a CRC-encoded image: length {len(encoded)} is not a "
            f"multiple of {BLOCK_TOTAL}"
        )

    bad = 0
    for off in range(0, len(encoded), BLOCK_TOTAL):
        block = encoded[off:off + BLOCK_DATA]
        stored = encoded[off + BLOCK_DATA:off + BLOCK_TOTAL]
        if crc16(block).to_bytes(2, "big") != stored:
            bad += 1
    return bad


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("infile", help="raw image, or encoded image with --verify")
    parser.add_argument("outfile", nargs="?", help="encoded output image")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verify",
        action="store_true",
        help="check the CRCs of an already-encoded image instead of encoding",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(args.infile, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()

    if args.verify:
        bad = verify(data)
        blocks = len(data) // BLOCK_TOTAL
        print(f"{args.infile}: {blocks} blocks, {bad} CRC mismatches")
        return 1 if bad else 0

    if not args.outfile:
        parser.error("outfile is required unless --verify is given")

    encoded = encode(data)
    with open(args.outfile, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(encoded)

    print(
        f"{args.infile}: {len(data)} bytes -> {args.outfile}: {len(encoded)} "
        f"bytes ({len(encoded) // BLOCK_TOTAL} blocks)"
    )

    # Re-read what we wrote so a corrupted write cannot go unnoticed.
    bad = verify(encoded)
    if bad:
        print(f"ERROR: {bad} blocks failed verification", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# BK7258 板级适配（声网对话式 AI 开发套件 R1）

openvela / NuttX 在 **博通集成 Beken BK7258** 上的板级支持包，目标硬件为
**声网对话式 AI 开发套件 R1（Agora ConvoAI Kit R1）**。

## 一、为什么放在这里

openvela 支持完全 out-of-tree 的芯片 + 板级移植：`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR`
和 `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR` 可以指向 `nuttx/` 之外的任意路径
（`vendor/sifli` 的 SF32LB52 移植就是这么做的）。因此本移植的全部代码都在参赛
仓内，**`nuttx/`、`packages/`、`vendor/` 等公共仓零改动**，符合参赛要求。

manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 把本目录软链到
`vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_252_board`，两个 CONFIG 路径都指向那里。

## 二、目录结构

```
board/contest_board/
├── chip/                    # BK7258 芯片层（→ CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR）
│   ├── bk7258_memorymap.h   # 内存映射与外设基址
│   ├── bk7258_uart.h        # UART 寄存器定义
│   ├── bk7258_gpio.[ch]     # GPIO / 引脚复用
│   ├── bk7258_clockconfig.[ch] # 外设时钟门控与时钟源选择
│   ├── bk7258_start.c       # 复位入口：VTOR/FPU/.data/.bss → nx_start()
│   ├── bk7258_irq.c         # NVIC 中断控制
│   ├── bk7258_timerisr.c    # SysTick 系统节拍
│   ├── bk7258_serial.c      # UART 字符设备驱动
│   ├── bk7258_lowputc.c     # 早期调试输出
│   ├── bk7258_allocateheap.c
│   ├── include/irq.h        # 60 个外设中断号
│   └── Kconfig / CMakeLists.txt / Make.defs
├── src/                     # 板级初始化
├── include/board.h          # 时钟与引脚约定

# https://stackoverflow.com/a/60604183
def crc16(data: bytes, initial_value: int = 0x0000) -> int:
    xor_in = initial_value  # initial value
    xor_out = 0x0000  # final XOR value
    poly = 0x8005  # generator polinom (normal form)

    reg = xor_in
    for octet in data:
        # reflect in
        for i in range(8):
            topbit = reg & 0x8000
            if octet & (0x80 >> i):
                topbit ^= 0x8000
            reg <<= 1
            if topbit:
                reg ^= poly
        reg &= 0xFFFF
        # reflect out
    return reg ^ xor_out

# openvela on BK7258 —— 声网对话式 AI 开发套件 R1 板级适配

## 一、作品简介

把 **openvela / NuttX 移植到博通集成（Beken）BK7258** 上，目标硬件是**声网对话式
AI 开发套件 R1（Agora ConvoAI Kit R1）**。BK7258 此前在 openvela 生态中没有任何
支持——`vendor/beken` 是个只有 CI 模板的空仓，`nuttx/arch` 与 `nuttx/boards` 下也
没有相关代码。本作品从零补齐了芯片层（BSP）、板级层、构建集成与烧录镜像打包链路。

亮点：

- **公共仓零改动。** 全部代码在参赛仓内，通过 `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR` /
  `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR` 挂进 openvela 构建树，`nuttx/`、`packages/`、
  `vendor/` 一行未改，完全符合参赛提交规范。
- **寄存器级事实全部有据可查。** 内存映射、60 个中断号、UART 寄存器位域、时钟门控
  位、引脚复用值，逐项来自 BK7258 Datasheet V2.1 与 Beken `bk_idk` SDK 源码，
  README 中标注了出处。
- **反推并验证了 Beken flash 的 CRC 编码格式。** BK7258 的 flash 控制器在 XIP 取指
  时做 CRC 校验（每 32 字节插 2 字节 CRC，物理:虚拟 = 34:32）。厂商的 CRC 工具只有
  Linux 版，我们对 SDK 中随附的已编码镜像做参数穷举，定出算法（MSB-first，多项式
  `0x8005`，初值 `0xFFFF`，大端存储），并在 3 个样本共 **3868 个块上逐块复算，零
  失配**，据此实现了跨平台的 Python 打包工具。
- **在 macOS（Apple Silicon）上打通了完整构建链路。**

## 二、选题方向

**新硬件适配**。BK7258 是国产 Armv8-M（STAR-MC1）三核 AMP 架构的 Wi-Fi 6 + BLE 5.4
多媒体 SoC，openvela 尚未支持，符合该赛道"选择尚未适配的硬件平台"的要求，且属于
评分说明中鼓励的"国产芯片平台"方向。

## 三、目录结构

```
board/contest_board/          板级适配代码（→ vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_252_board）
├── chip/                     BK7258 芯片层（CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR）
│   ├── bk7258_start.c        复位入口：VTOR / FPU / .data / .bss → nx_start()
│   ├── bk7258_irq.c          NVIC 中断控制（60 个外设中断）
│   ├── bk7258_timerisr.c     SysTick 系统节拍
│   ├── bk7258_serial.c       UART 字符设备驱动（/dev/console, /dev/ttyS0）
│   ├── bk7258_lowputc.c      早期调试输出与 UART 线路配置
│   ├── bk7258_clockconfig.c  外设时钟门控与时钟源选择
│   ├── bk7258_gpio.c         GPIO 与引脚复用
│   ├── bk7258_allocateheap.c 堆区划分
│   ├── bk7258_memorymap.h    内存映射与外设基址
│   ├── bk7258_uart.h         UART 寄存器定义
│   └── include/irq.h         中断号定义
├── src/                      板级初始化
├── include/board.h           时钟与引脚约定
├── scripts/ld.script         链接脚本（含 XIP 地址推导过程）
├── configs/nsh/defconfig     最小 NSH 基线配置
├── tools/bk_crc_pack.py      flash CRC 编码 / 校验工具
└── README.md                 详细技术文档（硬件事实表、flash 布局、烧录说明）

logs/                         AI Coding 日志
```

## 四、运行方式

### 1. 拉取工程

```bash
repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_252_EPG \
  -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_252_EPG.xml
repo sync -c -j8
```

manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 会把 `board/contest_board` 软链到
`vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_252_board`。

### 2. 编译

在 openvela 工作区根目录（本仓上一级）：

```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_252_board/configs/nsh --cmake -j8
```

产物：`cmake_out/contest2026_252_board_nsh/nuttx.bin`。

### 3. 生成可烧录镜像

```bash
python3 contest2026_252_EPG/board/contest_board/tools/bk_crc_pack.py \
    cmake_out/contest2026_252_board_nsh/nuttx.bin nuttx_crc.bin
```

### 4. 烧录

用 Beken 官方工具 **BKFIL**（Beken Flash Image Loader，v4 起提供
Windows/Linux/macOS 的 GUI 与 CLI，下载：<https://dl.bekencorp.com/tools/flash/>），
把 `nuttx_crc.bin` 写入 flash **物理偏移 `0x11000`**（app 分区），保留 bootloader
分区不动。

Type-C 线接开发板 `USB TO UART` 口；板载 CH340 接到 UART0（GPIO10/GPIO11），
控制台 **115200 8N1**。若烧录工具无法自动复位，手动按板子右侧 `RST` 键。

> ⚠️ 烧录会覆盖出厂的声网 AI Demo 固件。声网文档明确提示出厂固件与开源代码不可
> 混用，建议先用 BKFIL 完整读回 flash 做备份。

## 五、当前进度

| 阶段 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 芯片层（启动/中断/时钟/GPIO/UART/SysTick/堆） | ✅ 完成 |
| 板级层（defconfig / 链接脚本 / 板级初始化） | ✅ 完成 |
| openvela 构建集成 | ✅ 通过，macOS 上可复现 |
| 镜像布局验证 | ✅ 向量表位于镜像首字节，SP/复位地址正确 |
| flash CRC 打包 | ✅ 工具已实现并对厂商样本验证 |
| 真机启动验证 | ⏳ 待烧录（需 BKFIL，见下） |

构建产物已核对：

```
_vectors  0x02010000   ← 向量表在镜像首字节（bootloader 从这里取 SP/PC）
__start   0x02010130
初始 SP   0x28002464   ← _ebss + CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE，落在 SRAM 内
.data     0x28000000
```

**尚未在真机上验证启动。** 原因：BK7258 的 ROM 下载协议与社区工具 `bk7231tools`
支持的 BK7231 系列不兼容（链接超时），需要 Beken 官方的 BKFIL；而 Beken 下载站
`dl.bekencorp.com` 与文档站 `docs.bekencorp.com` 都启用了人机验证，需要用浏览器
手动获取。拿到 BKFIL 后，按第 4 节即可烧录验证。

## 六、AI Coding 使用说明

本作品全程由 AI（Claude Code）辅助完成，典型协作环节：

- **需求拆解与可行性判断**：先读参赛规范与赛道要求，再对照 openvela 源码树确认
  BK7258 确实未被支持，并找到 `vendor/sifli` 的 SF32LB52 移植作为 out-of-tree
  芯片移植的可行范例，据此确定"公共仓零改动"的技术路线。
- **硬件事实提取**：从 BK7258 Datasheet 与 Beken `bk_idk` SDK 中定位并交叉验证

- **编码**：按 NuttX 的 arch/chip 接口契约实现芯片层，参照同构的 Armv8-M 移植
  对齐代码风格与 API 约定。
- **调试**：编译错误逐轮定位修复（`board` target 重名、NVIC 宏签名不匹配、
  `up_prioritize_irq` 的 Kconfig 依赖、SysTick tick 源缺失、build-id 段挤占
  向量表位置等）。
- **逆向**：厂商 CRC 工具无 macOS 版，通过对已编码样本做参数穷举定出算法并全量
  验证，绕开了平台限制。

完整对话日志见 `logs/` 目录。

=== linking.py ===
#  Copyright (c) Kuba Szczodrzyński 2024-3-5.

from binascii import crc32
from time import sleep

from serial import Timeout

from .base import BK7231SerialInterface, BkBootloaderType, BkChipType, BkProtocolType
from .base.packets import (
    BkBootVersionCmnd,
    BkBootVersionResp,
    BkLinkCheckCmnd,
    BkLinkCheckResp,
    BkReadRegCmnd,
    BkSetBaudRateCmnd,
)


class BK7231SerialLinking(BK7231SerialInterface):
    def connect(self):
        # try to communicate
        if not self.wait_for_link(self.link_timeout):
            raise TimeoutError("Timed out attempting to link with chip")
        # update the transmission baud rate
        if self.serial.baudrate != self.baudrate:
            self.set_baudrate(self.baudrate)
        # identify the connected chip
        self.detect_chip()
        # identify the flash type
        try:
            self.flash_read_id()
        except NotImplementedError:
            pass
        if not self.flash_size and self.flash_params:
            self.flash_size = self.flash_params["size"]
        if not self.flash_size and self.bootloader_type:
            self.flash_size = self.bootloader_type.value.flash_size
        if not self.flash_size:
            self.flash_size = self.flash_detect_size()
            self.flash_size_detected = True

    def close(self):
        if self.serial and not self.serial.closed:
            self.serial.close()
            self.serial = None

    def wait_for_link(self, timeout: float) -> bool:
        tm = Timeout(timeout)
        tm_prev = self.serial.timeout
        self.serial.timeout = 0.005

        command = BkLinkCheckCmnd()
        connected = False
        while not tm.expired():
            try:
                response: BkLinkCheckResp = self.command(command)
                if response and response.value == 0:
                    connected = True
                    break
            except ValueError:
                pass

        self.drain()
        self.serial.timeout = tm_prev
        return connected

    def set_baudrate(self, baudrate: int) -> None:
        command = BkSetBaudRateCmnd(baudrate, delay_ms=20)

        def baudrate_cb():
            self.debug("-- UART: Changing port baudrate")
            sleep(command.delay_ms / 1000 / 2)
            self.serial.baudrate = baudrate

        self.command(command, after_send=baudrate_cb)

    def detect_chip(self) -> None:
        # try bootloader CRC matching first
        # all known protocols support this command
        crc = self.read_flash_range_crc(0, 256)
        self.bootloader_type = BkBootloaderType.get_by_crc(crc)

        if self.bootloader_type:
            # if bootloader is known, set protocol_type and chip_type
            self.protocol_type = self.bootloader_type.value.protocol
            self.chip_type = self.bootloader_type.value.chip
            self.bootloader = self.bootloader_type.value
        else:
            # if bootloader is not known, try to guess the protocol type
            self.chip_type = None
            self.bootloader = None
            self.warn(
                f"Unknown bootloader CRC - 0x{crc:08X}"
                f" - please report this on GitHub issues!"
            )
            # check CRC of app data, which is readable on all protocols
            check_offset = 0x11000
            check_length = 256
            crc = self.read_flash_range_crc(
                start=check_offset,
                end=check_offset + check_length,
            )
            data = self.flash_read_bytes(
                start=check_offset,
                length=check_length + 1,
                crc_check=False,
            )
            # guess the protocol type
            if crc == crc32(data[0 : check_length + 1]):
                # BK72xx BootROM protocol - CRC range end-inclusive
                self.protocol_type = BkProtocolType.FULL
            elif crc == crc32(data[0 : check_length + 0]):
                # BK72xx Bootloader protocol - assume minimal command support
                self.protocol_type = BkProtocolType.BASIC_BEKEN
            else:
                # CRC does not match - fail
                raise ValueError("CRC mismatch while checking chip type!")

        if self.check_protocol(BkReadRegCmnd):
            # read BK72xx BootROM SCTRL_CHIP_ID
            self.bk_chip_id = self.register_read(0x800000)
            # match the chip by ID
            if any(c.value == self.bk_chip_id for c in BkChipType):
                self.chip_type = BkChipType(self.bk_chip_id)
            else:
                self.warn(
                    f"Unknown SCTRL_CHIP_ID - {hex(self.bk_chip_id)}"
                    f" - please report this on GitHub issues!"
                )

        if self.check_protocol(BkBootVersionCmnd):
            # read BK7231T boot version
            command = BkBootVersionCmnd()
            response: BkBootVersionResp = self.command(command)
            if response.version != b"\x07":
                self.bk_boot_version = response.version.decode().strip("\x00\x20")

        self.info(
            f"BK72xx connected - "
            f"protocol: {self.protocol_type.name}, "
            f"chip: {self.chip_type and self.chip_type.name}, "
            f"bootloader: {self.bootloader_type and self.bootloader_type.name}, "
            f"chip ID: {self.bk_chip_id and hex(self.bk_chip_id)}, "
            f"boot version: {self.bk_boot_version}"
        )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe a Beken chip's bootrom over UART.

Resets the chip with DTR/RTS, then floods CMD_LinkCheck and reports anything
that comes back.  Tries several baud rates and several reset-line polarities,
because how DTR/RTS are wired to CEN/BOOT differs per board.
"""
import sys
import time

import serial

PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
LINK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"  # preamble + len + CMD_LinkCheck
RESP_PREAMBLE = b"\x04\x0e"

BAUDS = [115200, 921600, 460800, 1500000, 2000000, 3000000]


def reset(ser, mode):
    """Pulse the reset lines. mode picks which line drives reset."""
    if mode == "dtr":
        ser.dtr = True
        ser.rts = False
        time.sleep(0.08)
        ser.dtr = False
    elif mode == "rts":
        ser.rts = True
        ser.dtr = False
        time.sleep(0.08)
        ser.rts = False
    elif mode == "both":
        ser.rts = True
        ser.dtr = True
        time.sleep(0.08)
        ser.dtr = False
        time.sleep(0.05)
        ser.rts = False
    elif mode == "bk7231tools":
        # exactly what bk7231tools hw_reset() does
        ser.rts = True
        ser.dtr = True
        time.sleep(0.1)
        ser.dtr = False
        time.sleep(0.1)
        ser.rts = False
    time.sleep(0.02)


def flood(ser, seconds):
    """Send link checks continuously; return everything received."""
    got = bytearray()
    deadline = time.time() + seconds
    ser.reset_input_buffer()
    while time.time() < deadline:
        ser.write(LINK)
        ser.flush()
        time.sleep(0.002)
        n = ser.in_waiting
        if n:
            got += ser.read(n)
            if RESP_PREAMBLE in got:
                break
    return bytes(got)


def main():
    modes = sys.argv[1:] or ["bk7231tools", "dtr", "rts", "both", "none"]
    for baud in BAUDS:
        for mode in modes:
            try:
                ser = serial.Serial(PORT, baud, timeout=0.01)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                print(f"open failed: {exc}")
                return 1
            try:
                if mode != "none":
                    reset(ser, mode)
                data = flood(ser, 2.0)
            finally:
                ser.close()

            if data:
                hit = RESP_PREAMBLE in data
                mark = "  <<< RESPONSE" if hit else ""
                print(f"baud={baud:<8} reset={mode:<12} "
                      f"rx={len(data):4d}B  {data[:32].hex(' ')}{mark}")
                if hit:
                    print("\nBootrom responded. Full frame:", data.hex(" "))
                    return 0
            else:
                print(f"baud={baud:<8} reset={mode:<12} rx=   0B")
    print("\nNo response from any combination.")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# ARMINO 固件烧录

本 Skill 是 BKFIL 公共能力 API 客户端，只提交协议定义的 `raw_task` 任务，不直接访问串口或内部执行链路，也不启动、拉起、重启或守护 BKFIL 主程序。
本 Skill 是自包含的：协议说明和 `raw_task.args` 组装规则随 skill 存放在 `references/`，执行时不得依赖其它工程目录中的文档或源码。

## 面向客户的沟通

面向不懂内部实现的最终客户，执行命令 / 开面板 / 报结果时：

1. **先解释再动作**：开面板或跑脚本前，一句话说清「做什么、为什么、需要你做什么」。
2. **少追问**：能自动发现或用配置面板补齐的（串口、路径）不逐项文字追问；需客户定夺的（芯片 / 方案 / 工程 / TAG）用带说明的选项一次问清。
3. **不外抛原始输出**：`SCAN_xxx:`、`NEXT_ACTION_CMD:`、`DETAILS:{...}` 等仅供 AI 判断，对客户只讲结论和下一步，不贴原始日志 / 命令 / JSON。
4. **报错说人话**：说清「哪一步、为什么、怎么办」，把 `PORT_BUSY`、`FLASH_FAILED` 等错误码翻成人话并给可操作指引。

## 执行流程（必须按序，勿跳步）

1. **先 `scan`**：任何烧录动作前先跑一次 `--action scan`。它会一次性体检本地配置（串口 / 模式 / 远程主机 / 固件）并在最后检查 BKFIL 连通性，即使 BKFIL 未启动也会先把本地缺口列全。
2. **看脚本输出的 `NEXT_ACTION_CMD`**：脚本发现配置缺失或不可达时，会打印一行现成的开面板命令（`NEXT_ACTION_CMD:`）。**先用一句话向客户说明"接下来打开配置面板填 XX（如串口），因为烧录需要知道 XX"，再照抄执行该命令打开面板**——用面板做结构化输入，而不是用文字逐项追问"本机还是远程 / 串口是多少"。
3. **面板保存后重新读取配置并重试**：`--oneshot` 保存退出码 0、取消退出码 2；保存后重跑 `scan`，通过后再 `download`。
4. **仅当脚本明确提示 BKFIL 不可达且非配置问题时**，才提示用户"启动本机/远程 BKFIL（≥4.1.3）"。Skill 不自行拉起 BKFIL。

> 关键原则：优先让**脚本输出**驱动下一步（`NEXT_ACTION` / `NEXT_ACTION_CMD` / `SCAN_CONFIG_INCOMPLETE`），而不是靠 AI 自行推断。缺配置时优先开面板（用面板收集参数，不逐项文字追问）；但**开面板前先用一句人话说明要配什么、为什么**，别把这些 `SCAN_/NEXT_ACTION_` 原始信号直接甩给客户。

## 协议参考

使用 `raw-task` / `raw` 模式前，应先读取本 skill 内置的协议参考，确认公共 API 边界和 `raw_task.args` 组装方式：

1. `references/README.md`：总体边界和职责。
2. `references/api.md`：公共 API、任务模型、事件、文件上传/下载和错误处理。
3. `references/raw-task-commands.md`：`raw_task.args` 的 `bk_loader` 子命令参数组装方式。
4. `api.md` 约束公共 API 边界；`raw-task-commands.md` 只用于组装传给 BKFIL 托管 `bk_loader` 的参数数组。

> **前置条件**：需 **BKFIL ≥ 4.1.3**（下载地址：<https://dl.bekencorp.com/tools/bkfil/v4>）。Skill 不自行拉起 BKFIL。

协议流程：

```text
GET /v1/capabilities
POST /v1/files/upload?purpose=raw_input&name=<file>   # 输入文件型任务按需使用
POST /v1/tasks/start type=raw_task, raw_task.args=[...]
WS /v1/tasks/{task_id}/events
可选 GET /v1/files/{file_id}/download 或 GET /v1/files/download?path=...
可选 POST /v1/tasks/{task_id}/cancel
```

## 功能点

- `scan`：检查 BKFIL 公共能力 API、`raw_task` / `task_events` / `file_upload` / `file_download` 能力、默认固件路径和本地配置。
- `download`：先上传固件到 BKFIL 本机缓存目录，再创建 `type=raw_task` 烧录任务，组装 `bk_loader download` 参数，并订阅任务事件直到完成或失败。`raw_task download` 是同端口 exclusive 任务，串口抢占、shared 日志挂起、句柄释放/必要时 force close、完成后恢复共享任务都由 BKFIL 统一仲裁入口处理。
- `raw-task` / `raw`：通用 `raw_task.args` 入口。AI/tool 可按 `raw-task-commands.md` 组装 `read`、`erase`、`tools getbus`、`inject_key` 等参数数组，由 BKFIL 托管 `bk_loader` 执行；脚本只负责配置、能力检查、端口一致性校验、任务启动和事件订阅，不解释各子命令语义。

## 这一轮的进展

**协议层面我摸清楚了**（这些是实测结果，不是推测）：
- BK7258 bootrom **确实响应**：115200 + DTR/RTS 硬件复位 → LinkCheck 回 `04 0e 01 00`
- 之前 `bk7231tools` 失败的原因找到了：它的 `connect()` 从不调用 `hw_reset()`，纯靠手动按 Reset 撞时机
- 但 BK7258 的**命令集与 BK7231 不同**——`ReadReg(0x03)` 不被支持，发过去 bootrom 就退出下载模式去启动 app 了
- 顺带确认：**UART0/115200 就是控制台**，出厂固件正常启动时会打印（`driver_init end`、`sensor:W(10):uncali sdmadc`）。所以 NuttX 烧进去后我能直接从这个口看到 NSH

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Put a BK7258 into its ROM download mode and hand the port straight back.

The Agora ConvoAI Kit R1 does not respond to the reset pulse that
``bk_loader --reset_type 0`` emits, so ``bk_loader`` sits at "Please reset the
chip" until it times out.  This script drives the reset lines with the
sequence the board *does* answer to, confirms the bootrom is listening, and
then releases the port immediately so ``bk_loader`` can link without needing a
reset of its own.

Chain the two together so the gap stays in the milliseconds:

    ./enter_bootrom.py /dev/cu.usbserial-310 && \\
        bk_loader read -p /dev/cu.usbserial-310 ...

Exit status is 0 once the bootrom has acknowledged, 1 on timeout.
"""

import sys
import time

import serial

# Command framing: preamble, length, opcode.  CMD_LinkCheck carries no payload.
LINK_CHECK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"

# The bootrom answers a link check with this 4-byte frame: response preamble
# 04 0e, then opcode 0x01 and status 0x00.
RESP_PREAMBLE = b"\x04\x0e"

LINK_BAUD = 115200
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 8.0


def pulse_reset(ser):
    """Drive the reset lines with the sequence this board responds to."""
    ser.rts = True
    ser.dtr = True
    time.sleep(0.1)
    ser.dtr = False
    time.sleep(0.1)
    ser.rts = False
    time.sleep(0.02)


def enter_bootrom(port, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT):
    ser = serial.Serial(port, LINK_BAUD, timeout=0.01)
    try:
        # Leave the lines idle first; a line left asserted by an earlier tool
        # holds the chip in reset and nothing will ever answer.
        ser.dtr = False
        ser.rts = False
        time.sleep(0.05)

        pulse_reset(ser)
        ser.reset_input_buffer()

        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            ser.write(LINK_CHECK)
            ser.flush()
            time.sleep(0.002)
            if ser.in_waiting and RESP_PREAMBLE in ser.read(ser.in_waiting):
                return True
        return False
    finally:
        # Release the lines and the port so the next tool starts from a clean
        # state; a still-asserted DTR/RTS would hold the chip in reset.
        try:
            ser.dtr = False
            ser.rts = False
        finally:
            ser.close()


def main():
    port = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
    timeout = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else DEFAULT_TIMEOUT

    if enter_bootrom(port, timeout):
        print(f"{port}: bootrom is listening")
        return 0

    print(f"{port}: no response from bootrom within {timeout}s", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read the whole BK7258 flash to a file via the BK72xx bootrom protocol."""
import sys
import time

from bk7231tools.serial import BK7231Serial

PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
BAUD = 1500000
OUT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "factory_full.bin"
SIZE = 0x800000  # 8 MB
CHUNK = 0x10000  # 64 KB per progress step

s = BK7231Serial(port=PORT, baudrate=BAUD, link_baudrate=BAUD, link_timeout=15.0)
s.info = lambda *a, **k: None
s.warn = lambda *a, **k: None
s.hw_reset()
s.connect()
print(f"linked, flash size {s.flash_size} bytes", flush=True)

t0 = time.time()
with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
    done = 0
    while done < SIZE:
        n = min(CHUNK, SIZE - done)
        data = s.flash_read_bytes(start=done, length=n, crc_check=True)
        if len(data) != n:
            print(f"short read at 0x{done:06x}: {len(data)} != {n}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        fh.write(data)
        done += n
        pct = done * 100 // SIZE
        el = time.time() - t0
        print(f"\r0x{done:06x}/{SIZE:#x}  {pct:3d}%  {done/el/1024:.0f} KB/s",
              end="", flush=True)
print(f"\ndone in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s -> {OUT}")
s.close()

## 七、串口

开发套件 R1 板载 CH340（VID `0x1A86` / PID `0x7523`）接到 UART0，
即 GPIO10/GPIO11。控制台参数 **115200 8N1**。

macOS 下设备节点形如 `/dev/cu.usbserial-xxx`。

## 八、烧录：这块板子的实测坑

以下都是在真机上验证过的结论，直接照搬厂商文档会踩坑。

### 8.1 flash 实际型号

bootrom 报告 flash MID `0x1765c8`：厂商 `0xc8`（GigaDevice），容量位 `0x17`
即 2^23 = **8MB**，与 datasheet 中 QFN88 封装的 8MB SiP flash 一致。

### 8.2 `bk_loader` 的自动复位在本板无效

`bk_loader` 的 `--reset_type 0`（DTR/RTS）在本板上**不能复位芯片**，表现为一直卡在

```
Please reset the chip
Waiting reset......
Get bus failed
```

而且 `--retrycnt` 并不会延长这个 10 秒窗口。声网文档对此有过提示——"当烧录工具
无法自动重启开发板时，可以手动重启"。

本目录的 `tools/enter_bootrom.py` 用本板确实响应的时序完成复位并确认 bootrom
已在监听，然后立刻释放串口，供后续工具接手：

```bash
python3 tools/enter_bootrom.py /dev/cu.usbserial-310 && \
    bk_loader read -p /dev/cu.usbserial-310 ...
```

### 8.3 bootrom 的链接波特率

一个容易误判的点：在 **115200** 下对 bootrom 发 `CMD_LinkCheck`
（`01 e0 fc 01 00`）会收到看似合法的 4 字节 `04 0e 01 00`，很容易被当成"协议不
兼容的精简帧"。实际在 **1500000** 下收到的是完整帧：

```
04 0e 05 01 e0 fc 01 00
└preamble┘ └─echo──┘ └code=0x01, status=0x00
```

这正是标准 BK72xx BootROM 帧格式，115200 下那个短帧只是波特率不匹配的误读。

因此用社区工具 `bk7231tools` 时，**link_baudrate 必须一并设成 1500000**——它的
CLI 把链接波特率写死为 115200，只能走 API：

```python
from bk7231tools.serial import BK7231Serial
s = BK7231Serial(port="/dev/cu.usbserial-310",
                 baudrate=1500000, link_baudrate=1500000)
s.hw_reset()
s.connect()          # protocol: FULL, flash size: 8 MB
```

### 8.4 CRC 算法的真机交叉验证

从芯片读回的 flash 原始字节是 **CRC 编码后的物理数据**（`bk_loader read` 不做解
码）。用 `tools/bk_crc_pack.py --verify` 校验读回的 bootloader 区，120 个块**零失
配**——这在真实硬件上再次确认了第四节中逆向得到的 CRC 参数。

同时也说明：写入时喂给烧录工具的必须是 **CRC 编码后**的镜像（即 `nuttx_crc.bin`），
地址用**物理**偏移 `0x11000`。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write the CRC-encoded NuttX image into the BK7258 app partition."""
import os
import sys
import time

from bk7231tools.serial import BK7231Serial

PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
BAUD = 1500000
IMAGE = sys.argv[1]
START = 0x11000  # app partition, physical offset; bootloader occupies 0x0-0x11000

size = os.path.getsize(IMAGE)
end = START + size
print(f"image  : {IMAGE}  {size} bytes")
print(f"target : 0x{START:06x} .. 0x{end:06x}")
assert START % 0x1000 == 0, "start must be 4K aligned"

s = BK7231Serial(port=PORT, baudrate=BAUD, link_baudrate=BAUD, link_timeout=15.0)
s.info = lambda *a, **k: None
s.warn = print
s.hw_reset()
s.connect()
print(f"linked, flash size {s.flash_size}")

t0 = time.time()
written = 0
with open(IMAGE, "rb") as fh:
    for chunk in s.program_flash(fh, size, START, crc_check=True):
        written += chunk
        pct = written * 100 // size
        print(f"\rwritten {written}/{size}  {pct:3d}%", end="", flush=True)
print(f"\nwrote {written} bytes in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

# Read the region back and compare against what we intended to write.
print("verifying...")
with open(IMAGE, "rb") as fh:
    expected = fh.read()
readback = s.flash_read_bytes(start=START, length=size, crc_check=True)
if readback == expected:
    print(f"VERIFY OK: {size} bytes match")
    rc = 0
else:
    diff = sum(1 for a, b in zip(readback, expected) if a != b)
    print(f"VERIFY FAILED: {diff} differing bytes", file=sys.stderr)
    rc = 1
s.close()
sys.exit(rc)

       { \

                                 BK7258_UART_FIFO_STATUS_OFFSET); \
         volatile uint32_t *_tx = \

## 结果汇报

**成功的部分：**

| 环节 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| BK7258 芯片层 + 板级层 | 2723 行 C/H，openvela 构建通过，干净重建可复现 |
| 出厂固件备份 | 完整 8MB，两次独立读取互证，CRC 块结构零失配，SHA256 已存档 |
| 烧录 | 写入 `0x11000` 成功，**回读 217430 字节逐字节一致** |
| CRC 算法 | 逆向所得参数在**真机 flash 数据**上复算零失配（不只是 SDK 样本） |

**没成功的部分：烧录后未观测到启动输出。**

关键的判别实验推翻了我先前的猜测：我原以为是"部分覆盖破坏了出厂 app 的哈希"，但**把出厂固件从备份原样恢复回去后，出厂固件同样不启动**。所以当前不启动与烧进去的内容无关——不是我们的移植代码、不是镜像格式、也不是烧录质量的问题。

我也排除了"缺文件头"这一项：出厂 app 在 `0x11000` 处同样是直接的向量表（SP `0x2803c800`、Reset `0x020dafa1`），和我们的布局一致。

**板子是安全的**，随时能再烧：芯片始终在 1.5M 下响应 bootrom 的 LinkCheck，供电正常、工具可访问，出厂内容已完整恢复。

## 建议你做的一步

问题指向板子侧的启动/复位路径。这块板的 DTR/RTS 兼作下载模式选通，驱动它们只会进下载模式；而调试期间板子还自行掉电过一次。建议：

1. **拔掉 USB 线**，等几秒
2. 重新插上，**长按电源键 3 秒**开机，确认指示灯亮
3. 告诉我一声——我用完全不占串口的方式监听，你再按 RST

如果这样出厂固件能启动，说明只是下载模式锁定/供电问题，那我把 NuttX 重新烧回去（8 秒的事）就能验证 NSH。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hunt for the BK7258 ROM download window across baud rates.

Tolerates the USB serial device going away and coming back, which is what
happens when the cable is replugged mid-hunt.
"""
import os
import sys
import time

import serial

PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
LINK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"
RESP = b"\x04\x0e"
BAUDS = [115200, 1500000, 921600, 2000000, 460800]
DURATION = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 90.0

print(f"hunting {DURATION:.0f}s across {len(BAUDS)} baud rates", flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
hit = None
rounds = 0

while time.time() - t0 < DURATION and not hit:
    for baud in BAUDS:
        if time.time() - t0 >= DURATION or hit:
            break
        if not os.path.exists(PORT):
            time.sleep(0.3)
            continue
        try:
            s = serial.Serial(PORT, baud, timeout=0.005)
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.3)
            continue
        try:
            s.dtr = False
            s.rts = False
            s.reset_input_buffer()
            end = time.time() + 1.0
            while time.time() < end:
                s.write(LINK)
                s.flush()
                time.sleep(0.002)
                if s.in_waiting:
                    data = s.read(s.in_waiting)
                    if RESP in data:
                        hit = (baud, data)
                        break
        except Exception:
            # device yanked mid-round; just move on to the next attempt
            pass
        finally:
            try:
                s.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        rounds += 1

if hit:
    print(f"HANDSHAKE baud={hit[0]}  {hit[1][:16].hex(' ')}")
    sys.exit(0)
print(f"no response after {rounds} rounds")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Wait indefinitely for a BK7258 reset window, then flash and verify.

bk_loader gives up after a fixed ~10s window, which turns flashing into a game
of pressing RST at exactly the right moment.  This keeps hammering the link
check until the chip answers, so *any* reset gets caught -- press RST whenever
you like.

Usage: persist_flash.py <image> <start_addr_hex> [port]
"""
import os
import sys
import time

import serial
from bk7231tools.serial import BK7231Serial

LINK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"
RESP = b"\x04\x0e"
LINK_BAUDS = [115200, 1500000]
XFER_BAUD = 1500000


def wait_for_chip(port):
    """Block until the chip answers a link check. Returns the baud it spoke."""
    attempt = 0
    while True:
        for baud in LINK_BAUDS:
            attempt += 1
            if not os.path.exists(port):
                time.sleep(0.5)
                continue
            try:
                ser = serial.Serial(port, baud, timeout=0.005)
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.3)
                continue
            try:
                ser.dtr = False
                ser.rts = False
                ser.reset_input_buffer()
                end = time.time() + 1.0
                while time.time() < end:
                    ser.write(LINK)
                    ser.flush()
                    time.sleep(0.002)
                    if ser.in_waiting and RESP in ser.read(ser.in_waiting):
                        print(f"\nchip answered at {baud} baud "
                              f"(after {attempt} probes)", flush=True)
                        return baud
            except Exception:
                pass
            finally:
                try:
                    ser.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if attempt % 10 == 0:
                print(f"\rwaiting for reset... {attempt} probes "
                      f"(press RST any time)", end="", flush=True)


def main():
    image = sys.argv[1]
    start = int(sys.argv[2], 16)
    port = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"
    size = os.path.getsize(image)

    print(f"image : {image}  {size} bytes")
    print(f"target: 0x{start:06x}..0x{start + size:06x}")
    assert start % 0x1000 == 0, "start must be 4K aligned"

    link_baud = wait_for_chip(port)

    # The window is open now; connect straight away on the same baud.
    for attempt in range(1, 40):
        try:
            s = BK7231Serial(port=port, baudrate=XFER_BAUD,
                             link_baudrate=link_baud, link_timeout=2.0)
            s.info = lambda *a, **k: None
            s.warn = print
            s.connect()
            break
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"connect attempt {attempt} failed: {exc}", flush=True)
            try:
                s.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            # Chip may have dropped back out; hunt for it again.
            link_baud = wait_for_chip(port)
    else:
        print("could not establish a session", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"linked, flash size {s.flash_size}", flush=True)

    t0 = time.time()
    written = 0
    with open(image, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in s.program_flash(fh, size, start, crc_check=True):
            written += chunk
            print(f"\rwriting {written}/{size} "
                  f"({written * 100 // size}%)", end="", flush=True)
    print(f"\nwrote {written} bytes in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

    with open(image, "rb") as fh:
        expected = fh.read()
    readback = s.flash_read_bytes(start=start, length=size, crc_check=True)
    s.close()

    if readback == expected:
        print(f"VERIFY OK: {size} bytes match")
        return 0
    diff = sum(1 for a, b in zip(readback, expected) if a != b)
    print(f"VERIFY FAILED: {diff} differing bytes", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

文档已全部对齐。

## 收尾总结

**板子安全**：出厂固件已恢复并验证（写入 221184 字节、回读逐字节一致），眼睛动画回来了。

**这一轮解决的两个问题：**

1. **烧录时序难题**——根因是本板 CH340 的控制线没接到芯片 CEN 复位脚，官方 `bk_loader` 无法自动复位，而它的等待窗口固定 10 秒，只能盲按 RST 去撞（实测连续 35 轮没中）。我写了 [bk_flash.py](contest2026_252_EPG/board/contest_board/tools/bk_flash.py)：**不设超时**，持续发握手包直到芯片应答。换上之后**一次就成**，你只按了一次 RST。这个之前该早点想到，让你白按了很多轮。

2. **NuttX 不启动的定位**——探针实验给了明确答案：在 `__start()` 第一条指令就往 UART0 的非安全别名和安全别名各写一个字符，烧录后复位**两个都没出现**。这排除了烧录质量、镜像格式、安全态假设、串口监听方式四条，结论是 **bootloader 根本没跳转**——它会先校验 app 分区（二进制里有 `img hash err!`、`head CRC32 fail.`、`body CRC32 failed.`、`jump toxx:0x%x`），而我们的镜像没带它要的校验头。

Bootloader和常规Ota简介
========================

:link_to_translation:`en:[English]`

一.概述
----------------------------

该文档主要介绍系统启动和OTA流程，用于指导从事BSP开发和维护的相关工程师理解系统的启动和OTA过程，更好分析和解决问题。

二.启动模块介绍
----------------------------

启动模块涉及到bootrom, bootloader,applications，启动过程如下:

- 1.CPU启动之后首先跳转到ROM地址上，执行ROM code。
- 2.如果EFUSE中开启了安全boot，则进行验签，验签成功后，设置reboot信号，系统从flash中启动。
- 3.如果EFUSE中没有启动安全boot,则设置reboot信号，系统从flash中启动。
- 4.Flash中先执行bootloader代码。
- 5.Bootloader代码执行完之后跳转到applications代码。

三.Bootloader简介
----------------------------

Bootloader分为l_bootloader和up_bootloader两个模块，l_bootloader实现uart下载功能；up_bootloader实现OTA升级功能。

二．l_bootloader简介
----------------------------

:link_to_translation:`en:[English]`

l_bootloader：主要是uart下载功能，流程图如上图2所示。

- 1.在romcode执行完成之后会跳转到flash的0x0地址执行；
- 2.此时会判断uart rx_buf中有是否有数据，如果有数据，抢占到uart总线进入数据下载状态，下载完成之后会reboot；
- 3.如果此时uart rx_buf中没有数据，会循环检测一定次数后会跳转到指定地址（此为逻辑地址）处执行up_boot。

## 结论：不需要逆向，问题在我们自己的代码里

既然 bootloader 无条件跳转，那么**我们的代码大概率已经在执行**，只是没能把字打出来。之前那个"两个别名都没输出"的探针，其前提是"bootloader 会把 UART0 留在可用状态"——但 l_bootloader 用完 UART 后很可能关掉了时钟，那样探针会静默失效（宏里自旋超时后往一个没时钟的外设写，什么也不会发生）。

## 用现有资料能走的三条路

**A. 对照 SDK 源码重做 UART 上电时序（推荐，成本最低）**

我写时钟使能时只做了两件事：`0x44010030` bit2 开 UART0 时钟、`0x44010020` bit10 选 XTAL。但 **BK7258 有 PMU 电源域**，外设可能需要先上电——这一步我根本没做，纯属遗漏。SDK 里 `middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/{sys_ll,uart_ll,gpio_ll}.h` 和 `middleware/driver/uart/` 有完整的正确顺序，是源码不是二进制，照着核对就行。

**B. 加一个不依赖 UART 的执行证据**

UART 本身是嫌疑对象，就别用它来证明代码在跑。可以让启动代码**轮流翻转全部 56 个 GPIO**——板上有 LED，只要代码在执行，你就能看到闪烁。不需要原理图，暴力扫描即可。这能一刀切开"代码没跑"和"代码跑了但打不出字"。

**C. 用 SDK 编一个已知能跑的最小工程做对照**

我已经把 `download-armino-sdk`、`build-armino-project` 这些官方 skill 装进项目了，就是干这个的。编出一个能打印的最小 app，直接对比它的初始化序列。成本最高（要下 SDK、配工具链，可能要 Linux/Docker），但最权威。

## 我的建议

**先做 A + B**：按 SDK 源码补上电源域/时钟顺序，同时加 GPIO 扫描闪灯作为独立证据。一次烧录就能同时验证两件事——如果灯闪了但没串口输出，问题锁定在 UART；如果灯也不闪，才需要再往前查。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Flash a BK7258 without having to catch a 10-second reset window.

The CH340 on this board has its RTS#/CTS# pins unconnected (see the board
schematic), so nothing can pulse the chip's CEN pin: the only way to reset is
the RST button.  ``bk_loader`` waits about ten seconds for that and then gives
up, which turns flashing into a game of pressing RST at the right moment.

This script splits the job.  It hammers CMD_LinkCheck with no timeout until the
chip answers -- so a single RST press at any moment is enough -- and only then
hands the already-open session to ``bk_loader``, which does the actual erase
and write.  The chip stays in download mode once it has answered, so the
handover is safe.

Usage:
    bk_flash.py <image> <start_addr_hex> [port]
    bk_flash.py --read <outfile> <start_hex> <len_hex> [port]
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import serial

LINK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"
RESP = b"\x04\x0e"
LINK_BAUDS = [115200, 1500000]
XFER_BAUD = 1500000
DEFAULT_PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"


def wait_for_chip(port, announce_every=20):
    """Block until the chip answers a link check.  Returns the baud it used."""
    probes = 0
    print("waiting for the chip -- press RST once, any time", flush=True)
    while True:
        for baud in LINK_BAUDS:
            probes += 1
            if not os.path.exists(port):
                time.sleep(0.5)
                continue
            try:
                ser = serial.Serial(port, baud, timeout=0.005)
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.3)
                continue
            try:
                # Never drive DTR/RTS: on this board they are not wired to
                # CEN, and asserting them only confuses the CH340.
                ser.dtr = False
                ser.rts = False
                ser.reset_input_buffer()
                deadline = time.time() + 1.0
                while time.time() < deadline:
                    ser.write(LINK)
                    ser.flush()
                    time.sleep(0.002)
                    if ser.in_waiting and RESP in ser.read(ser.in_waiting):
                        print(f"chip is in download mode ({baud} baud, "
                              f"{probes} probes)", flush=True)
                        return baud
            except Exception:
                pass
            finally:
                try:
                    ser.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if probes % announce_every == 0:
                print(f"  still waiting ({probes} probes)...", flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Flash a BK7258 without having to catch a 10-second reset window.

The CH340 on this board has its RTS#/CTS# pins unconnected (see the board
schematic), so nothing can pulse the chip's CEN pin: the only way to reset is
the RST button.  ``bk_loader`` waits about ten seconds for that and then gives
up, which turns flashing into a game of pressing RST at the right moment.

This script splits the job.  It hammers CMD_LinkCheck with no timeout until the
chip answers -- so a single RST press at any moment is enough -- and only then
hands the already-open session to ``bk_loader``, which does the actual erase
and write.  The chip stays in download mode once it has answered, so the
handover is safe.

Usage:
    bk_flash.py <image> <start_addr_hex> [port]
    bk_flash.py --read <outfile> <start_hex> <len_hex> [port]
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import serial

LINK = b"\x01\xe0\xfc\x01\x00"
RESP = b"\x04\x0e"
LINK_BAUDS = [115200, 1500000]
XFER_BAUD = 1500000
DEFAULT_PORT = "/dev/cu.usbserial-310"


def wait_for_chip(port, announce_every=20):
    """Block until the chip answers a link check.  Returns the baud it used."""
    probes = 0
    print("waiting for the chip -- press RST once, any time", flush=True)
    while True:
        for baud in LINK_BAUDS:
            probes += 1
            if not os.path.exists(port):
                time.sleep(0.5)
                continue
            try:
                ser = serial.Serial(port, baud, timeout=0.005)
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.3)
                continue
            try:
                # Never drive DTR/RTS: on this board they are not wired to
                # CEN, and asserting them only confuses the CH340.
                ser.dtr = False
                ser.rts = False
                ser.reset_input_buffer()
                deadline = time.time() + 1.0
                while time.time() < deadline:
                    ser.write(LINK)
                    ser.flush()
                    time.sleep(0.002)
                    if ser.in_waiting and RESP in ser.read(ser.in_waiting):
                        print(f"chip is in download mode ({baud} baud, "
                              f"{probes} probes)", flush=True)
                        return baud
            except Exception:
                pass
            finally:
                try:
                    ser.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if probes % announce_every == 0:
                print(f"  still waiting ({probes} probes)...", flush=True)


def run_bk_loader(args):
    """Hand over to bk_loader, which owns the real flash protocol."""
    cmd = ["bk_loader"] + args
    print("-> " + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
    out = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
    text = out.stdout + out.stderr
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if any(k in line for k in ("Get bus", "Download complete",
                                   "Read complete", "fail", "Elapse",
                                   "flash mid")):
            print("   " + line.strip(), flush=True)
    return "all pass" in text


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--read":
        out_file, start, length = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
        port = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else DEFAULT_PORT
        wait_for_chip(port)
        ok = run_bk_loader([
            "read", "-p", port, "-b", str(XFER_BAUD), "--reset_type", "3",
            "-g", "300", "-f", f"{out_file}@{start}-{length}",
        ])
    else:
        image = sys.argv[1]
        start = sys.argv[2]
        port = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else DEFAULT_PORT
        print(f"image : {image}  {os.path.getsize(image)} bytes")
        print(f"target: {start}")
        wait_for_chip(port)
        ok = run_bk_loader([
            "download", "-p", port, "-b", str(XFER_BAUD), "--reset_type", "3",
            "-g", "300", "-e", "1", "-r", "-i", os.path.abspath(image),
            "-s", start,
        ])

    print("OK" if ok else "FAILED", flush=True)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def wait_for_chip(port, baud=115200, announce_every=2000):
    """Block until the chip answers a link check.

    The l_bootloader download window is only tens of milliseconds wide, so this
    must not leave gaps: the port is opened once and the link check goes out
    back to back until something answers.  An earlier version cycled baud rates
    and reopened the port each round, and lost RST presses in the seams.
    """
    probes = 0
    print(f"waiting for the chip at {baud} baud -- press RST once, any time",
          flush=True)

    while not os.path.exists(port):
        time.sleep(0.5)

    ser = serial.Serial(port, baud, timeout=0)
    try:
        # Never drive DTR/RTS: on this board they are not wired to CEN, and
        # asserting them only confuses the CH340.
        ser.dtr = False
        ser.rts = False
        ser.reset_input_buffer()

        while True:
            ser.write(LINK)
            probes += 1
            data = ser.read(64)
            if data and RESP in data:
                print(f"chip is in download mode ({probes} probes)", flush=True)
                return baud
            if probes % announce_every == 0:
                print(f"  still waiting ({probes} probes)...", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            ser.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

| 5 | 向量不动，桩覆盖出厂入口 `0xCAFA0` | ❌ 无反应 | 作废，见下 |

的整个方向**，与官方文档一致（download 分区为全 `0xFF` 时直接跳转、不校验）。
bootloader 二进制里的 `img hash err!`、`head CRC32 fail.` 属于 OTA 升级路径。

### 探针设计上踩过的坑

实验 3/4/5 的"无反应"**不能作为证据**，因为探针本身有缺陷。四次教训的共同点都是
**在未经验证的前提上建结论**：

1. **依赖 `SYSRESETREQ`。** 前两版探针靠写 `AIRCR` 自复位来证明"代码在跑"。但该

4. **误认指示灯。** 板子插 USB 时左下角常亮的绿灯是充电 IC `ETA4322` 驱动的充电

通电。`CONFIG_BK7258_LED_PROBE` 的最终版本先拉高 GPIO52 给 LDO 上电，再驱动
GPIO9 的马达——这是本目录里唯一一个前提都被核实过的探针。

git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add BK7258 board port for the Agora ConvoAI Kit R1

Brings up openvela/NuttX on the Beken BK7258 (Armv8-M STAR-MC1), which had
no support anywhere in the tree: vendor/beken holds only CI templates, and
neither nuttx/arch nor nuttx/boards mentions the part.

Everything lives in this repo.  The chip and board directories are pulled
into the openvela build through CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR and
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR, the same mechanism vendor/sifli uses for
SF32LB52, so nuttx/, packages/ and vendor/ are untouched.

Chip layer: reset entry, NVIC (60 peripheral interrupts), SysTick tick,
UART driver, GPIO/pin muxing, peripheral clock gating, heap.  Register
addresses, interrupt numbers, bit fields and pin mux values are all taken
from the BK7258 datasheet and the Beken bk_idk SDK rather than guessed.

Board layer: linker script deriving the XIP entry (0x02010000) from the
partition table, NSH defconfig, board init.

Two tools worth noting:

  bk_crc_pack.py encodes images for the flash controller, which verifies a
  CRC while fetching and stores two CRC bytes per 32 bytes of payload.  The
  vendor encoder ships Linux-only, so the parameters were recovered by
  brute-forcing them against CRC-encoded images in the SDK, then confirmed
  against bytes read back from the board -- zero mismatches either way.

  bk_flash.py works around a hardware limit: this board leaves the CH340
  RTS#/CTS# pins unconnected, so nothing can pulse CEN and bk_loader's
  ten-second reset window becomes a guessing game.  It probes without a
  timeout instead, so any single RST press is caught.

The port builds cleanly and produces a correctly laid out image, but NuttX
has not been observed booting on hardware.  Both READMEs record what the
real-hardware experiments established (the bootloader does not validate the
app image; altering the reset vector stops it booting) and, just as
importantly, which earlier conclusions were withdrawn once their probes
turned out to rest on unverified assumptions.
EOF

git push

- `role` — user / assistant / tool / system

## 安全特性

- **工作区门控**: 只在 openvela 工作区(向上能找到 `.repo/`)内采集,工作区外的对话(含个人项目)完全不采集
- **不自动上传**: 自动入仓只写本机仓内 `logs/` 文件,工具自身从不 `git push`,上传由选手控制
- **自动脱敏**: 默认正则覆盖 `sk-*` (API key) / `ghp_*` (GitHub token) / `Bearer *` (auth header)
- **TEAM_ID 缺失主动拒绝**: 防止数据归属错乱
- **多人组天然安全**: 按 `<github_login>/` 一人一目录,组员之间互不干扰
